title: Half-Life 2: Deathmatch
provenance: Reported by Swiss-Mac-User (highball-db#658, 2026-10-24), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, DXVK, sync off, rated 5 of 5 after 29 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXVK on an M5 Pro over 29 minutes. The frame rate drops for a moment on some maps and the first time some effects play, then recovers. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Short frame rate drops on some maps and the first time some effects play (reported on an M5 Pro, DXVK)
knownIssues.cause: likely shaders being compiled the first time they are needed. Not measured
knownIssues.fix: none needed, it recovers by itself
